items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: So I played brushes with him and he thought it was swing enough, he was very happy.

ctx.x: Uh huh. We can't recall his name.

And Basie, some night there, he would start, and he'd ask me "Do you want to play?" because I had played brushes one night, I didn't even pick up a stick. So I played brushes with him and he thought it was swing enough, he was very happy. That I could keep some time with him.
